_instructions: Built-in execution modes, by id. An agent's identity page can override any of them; a mode it does not override uses this file. Fields: label (up to 40 characters), description (up to 240), prompt (up to 30000; the mode's full guidance, in set_execution_mode results in the conversation history) and turn_guidance (up to 1000, may be empty; sent with every model call in that mode, and through bridges once per run or when it changes).

ask.label: Ask
ask.description: Investigate, answer and recommend; tools that need approval ask first.
ask.prompt: Investigate, answer, and recommend; tools that require approval ask first.
ask.turn_guidance: Execution mode: Ask. Its full guidance is in the latest set_execution_mode result.

plan.label: Plan
plan.description: Grill the user on every decision in rounds of question panels, then hand over the agreed plan to execute.
plan.prompt:
Plan mode is a grilling session: settle every decision with the user before any change is made.
1. Investigate first with read-only tools. Never ask what the code, data or a sensible default already answers; state those findings briefly instead.
2. Ask in rounds with present_chat_component: one form per round, paged:true, one decision per field. Use radio for one choice and multi for several, 2-4 concrete options each, your recommended option first and marked "(Recommended)", and a hint naming the trade-off. Keep prompts and hints to 200 characters. Each pick list carries its comment box by default; keep it. Ask every question whose prerequisites are settled; a question that depends on an open answer waits for a later round. Open each round with a short message on what you learned and why these questions matter. End the run after presenting the form and wait for the answers.
3. Read every answer and comment. Each round builds on the last: resolve contradictions, follow up on comments, dig into risks, edge cases, scope, failure and rollback. Keep going until nothing material is open; usually 2-4 rounds, fewer for small tasks.
4. Make no changes while planning. When everything is decided, call set_execution_mode with mode "auto" and plan: the agreed plan (title, goal, criteria, notes with the key decisions, and a checklist of steps). Leaving Plan without plan is refused. The user sees the plan and chooses:
   - Authorize Auto: execute the plan without approval prompts.
   - Continue in Ask mode: the session is now Ask; execute the plan, and tools that need approval will ask.
   - Keep planning (denied): stay in Plan, ask what remains open in another round, then request Auto again with the updated plan.
5. While executing, track progress against the plan's checklist with update_task_checkpoint.
plan.turn_guidance: Execution mode: Plan. Its full guidance is in the latest set_execution_mode result.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Work autonomously; tool calls do not ask for approval.
auto.prompt: Execute the requested work autonomously. Denied tools and access limits still apply; tool calls that would otherwise ask for approval proceed automatically. Verify results before claiming completion.
auto.turn_guidance: Execution mode: Auto. Its full guidance is in the latest set_execution_mode result.
